occasion: A segment that has to hold an audience across a commercial break.
counter: Ask what the anger is for. Outrage that cannot name a remedy is a product, not a politics.

confused_with.tell: The dramagogue wants your fear; the ragesturbationist wants your feed.

senses: The pattern of producing anger as a product: the segment timed to the break, the grievance renewed on schedule, the remedy never named.
It works because outrage travels further than explanation and needs no conclusion - so the one thing it must never supply is the thing that would end it.
example: *"He has zero intention of fixing the issue he screams about every night; he's a full-time **ragesturbationist** getting off on ad revenue and engagement while his followers burn down their own communities."*
